metadata.description: Captured POST /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}?action=Start (SINGULAR path — resumes a rollout previously paused via action=Stop). Canonical docs say 202 Accepted with an empty body; confirmed on the wire — same empty-body shape as action=Stop. Captured immediately after a Stop call against the same update+org group with one live deployment present.
